description:
Jasmine Sokko chose to sing to her own tune while her peers pursued more conventional pathways. Now a professional singer and music producer, she shares what it took for her to fulfil this childhood dream, growing up in an environment where productivity and stability are prized.

WATCH MORE Dear Singapore:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLkMf14VQEvTZFGPehHqgrLFRHoaR5g8Mu

00:00 Challenges in chasing an unconventional dream
01:32 Learning to deal with instability and unpredictability
02:32 Redetermining your self-worth
03:51 Turning adversity into inspiration
05:13 Every dream is equally worthy

Follow Jasmine Sokko: https://www.instagram.com/jasminesokko/

=======================
About the show: What does it take to dream differently? Remarkable Singaporeans share unconventional journeys in stories framed as personal ‘Dear Singapore’ letters — revealing hope, courage, resilience and love.
